subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kai Li <kai.li@codahealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Hi Kai —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, CodaHealth is looking to expand Redwood usage across two new product teams (Docs AI and Patient Insights). A quick outline of the items I want to align on so we can move toward a clean renewal + expansion: 

- Capacity uplift: estimated +40% token baseline for peak hours (Docs AI) and a +15% baseline for Patient Insights.
- Credentialing: additional API keys scoped per team, with namespace isolation recommended.
- Rollout: phased activation (Phase 1: Docs AI pilot — 2 weeks, Phase 2: Patient Insights full rollout — 6 weeks).
- Commercial: you mentioned re-evaluating term length at renewal — we can do an 18-month term in exchange for a blended discount and committed burst pool.

I've attached a very rough activation matrix to show how keys & namespaces would map. Can you confirm who from your side will own the internal project list and who needs early access? Once I have that, I can draft a formal expansion proposal and proposed amendment to your current contract.

Next step: are you available next Tue (9/29) for a 30-min pricing + rollout sync?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: activation-matrix-v1.csv (csv)
From: Kai Li <kai.li@codahealth.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Jordan —

Appreciate the summary. Sounds aligned. Quick answers:
- I'll own the internal project list with Sarah (engineering lead) as the technical contact.
- For budgeting I need a ballpark for the 40%/15% baselines and the cost for reserved burst capacity.
- We need to understand how keys are issued and rotated (policy & timeframe).

Tuesday 9/29 10:00am PT works for a brief call. I'll send a calendar invite and include Sarah.

Thanks,
Kai Li
Head of Platform Integrations | CodaHealth
kai.li@codahealth.ai

Attachment: Coda_Project_Roster.pdf (reference)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kai Li <kai.li@codahealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Kai —

Thanks, see the attached expansion proposal with an initial pricing sketch and staged activation timeline. Highlights:

- Pricing sketch (monthly blended): baseline +40% = +$6,200/month; baseline +15% = +$2,300/month; reserved burst pool (200k tokens/day) = +$1,800/month.
- Term proposal: 18 months with a 10% blended discount on token rates if signed with the renewal amendment.
- Keys & governance: we propose namespaced API keys per team (Docs-AI, PatientInsights) issued as scoped tokens; rotation cadence: 90 days by default, immediate revoke via console if needed.
- Activation plan: Phase 1 (Docs AI pilot): issue two dev keys + one prod key; Phase 2 (Patient Insights): issue three dev keys + two prod keys.

Attached files: 20260929-Coda-Expansion-Proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a one-page activation checklist.

If that looks good I'll route this to Contracts for an amendment draft tied to your existing account (DEAL-CH-4821).

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260929-Coda-Expansion-Proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Internal — quick note on negotiation posture before the call with Kai/Sarah on Monday: 

- Target: close expansion + 18mo amendment with 10% blended discount, commit to baseline uplift and a moderate reserved burst pool.
- Concessions we can offer: free first-month burst credits, accelerated key issuance (2-business-day SLA), and two onboarding sessions with Solutions Eng.
- Do NOT commit to unlimited burst or additional KMS/HSM integrations without SOC approval. If customer pushes on compliance beyond SOC2, loop in Security.

Laura: please have a draft amendment ready to share during the call (line items for baseline uplift, burst pool, and key-scoping). Ben/Marissa: I need an ops timeline for key issuance and who from Eng will perform the namespace mapping.

Thanks,
Jordan

(Internal note: do not include external recipients on this thread)
From: Kai Li <kai.li@codahealth.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Gomez <sarah@codahealth.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Jordan / Team —

We reviewed the proposal internally and are willing to move forward on the 18-month term with the 10% blended discount. A few operational questions before sign: 

1) Timeline for key issuance: we need prod keys for Docs AI within 10 business days of signing.
2) Staged rollout: confirm you can support a pilot traffic cap (25% of peak) for the first two weeks.
3) Compliance evidence: please share SOC2 artifact and a short note on data retention for keys/logs.

If you can confirm these items, I'll have our procurement team push the amendment through.

Best,
Kai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kai Li <kai.li@codahealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Additional team activation & renewal alignment

Kai / Sarah —

Great to hear — we can proceed. Confirmations and next steps: 

- Key issuance SLA: we will provision prod keys for Docs AI within 2 business days of countersigned amendment and within 10 business days of signature if you choose to sign later.
- Pilot traffic cap: we will enforce a 25% rate-limit gate for pilot weeks 1-2; Solutions Eng will monitor and report daily.
- SOC2 & retention: SOC2 Type II summary and redacted control matrix (SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf) attached; key rotation and audit log retention policy: 90 days of immediate logs, 12-month archived traces on request.

Attached: 20260929-Coda-Expansion-Proposal.xlsx, activation-matrix-v1.csv, SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPE/abc123-def456

I'll open a HubSpot task and create an ops ticket for key issuance. Proposed kickoff call: Mon 10/11 10:00am PT to review amendment and runbook — will send invite.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
